breakdown.description: Method section specifies dt=0.0005 with 1200 steps, which does not match the requested final time T=0.5.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification states 'dt = 0.0005 for 1200 time steps to reach T = 0.5', which is mathematically inconsistent (0.0005 × 1200 = 0.6 ≠ 0.5). The ground truth fixes this by using 1000 time steps (0.0005 × 1000 = 0.5). The agent repeated the original error instead of correcting the number of time steps to 1000.
